sessions.title: SDOL-018 audit log integration — code complete, compliance research
sessions.summary: Implemented full SAP BTP CF Audit Log Service integration for SDOL-018: created audit_log.py module with SEC-215-compliant payload, wired 19 emit() call sites across auth.py and 7 endpoint files, closed 3 issues (#801 SIEM, #805 retention, #807 AUTH_DISABLED), opened PR #819 draft. Researched and read SDOL-018, SEC-215, DPP-256 specs from product standards portal.
outcomes: audit_log.py created: OAuth2 token fetch + POST to BTP CF v2 endpoint; payload {uuid, user, time, ip, data} per audit-spec/security-event-example-v2.json
19 emit() call sites wired: 4 in auth.py, 15 across 7 endpoint files; all pass source_ip=request.client.host
Issues #801 (SIEM auto), #805 (retention auto), #807 (AUTH_DISABLED removed) closed with evidence
PR #819 draft opened — blocked on #802 (GAA needed to provision auditlog service in BTP)
Confirmed: SAP Audit Log Service has no Python SDK on PyPI — REST only; ALS NG is separate future service
SDOL-018 SIEM compliance path confirmed: list in Audit Log Documentation index (Google Form) → no CFC onboarding needed
Message sent to find GAA holder to provision auditlog (plan: oauth2) in BTP subaccount
